name: flexnetos-runner
description: FlexNetOS rUv-native GitHub runner harness (github-actions host). Generated by `nix run .#scaffold` (metaharness). Plain ESM — no build step.
comment: This manifest is the scaffold target. Run `nix run .#scaffold` to have metaharness generate bin/cli.js + package-lock.json into this directory, then `nix build .#metaharness` builds it hermetically. `flexnetos-runner init` boots kernel+host; `flexnetos-runner doctor` verifies the install.
